```{python}
# Reads analysis/phase2.py's TSVs from $PHASE2_RESULTS (default ../results/phase2).
# Render: `pixi run report2`, or PHASE2_RESULTS=<dir> quarto render report/phase2.qmd
# Everything is static: matplotlib figures and plain HTML tables, one self-contained HTML file.

# Full pipeline tab: trade-off weights and the thresholds. Edit and re-render.
WEIGHTS = {"accuracy": 1.0, "stability": 1.0, "cost": 1.0}
THRESHOLDS = {"accuracy": 0.8, "stability": 0.8}
import html
import os
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.ticker as mticker
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from IPython.display import display

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path("../analysis").resolve()))
import figures as fg  # omnicol and the shared figure style

R = Path(os.environ.get("PHASE2_RESULTS", "../results/phase2"))


def tsv(name):
    p = R / f"phase2_{name}.tsv"
    return pd.read_csv(p, sep="\t") if p.exists() else pd.DataFrame()


bounds, runs, stages = tsv("bounds"), tsv("runs"), tsv("stages")
pipes, pipe_runs, stage_conc = tsv("pipelines"), tsv("pipelines_runs"), tsv("stage_concordance")
leiden_tests = tsv("concordance_tests")
if not len(stages):
    raise RuntimeError(f"no phase2_stages.tsv in {R}: run analysis/phase2.py first")

datasets = sorted(stages["dataset"].unique())
PIPE_ORDER = ["baseline", "scanpy-defaults", "tuned-cpu", "all-gpu", "hybrid"]
PIPE_COLOUR = {p: fg.OMNICOL[i] for i, p in enumerate(PIPE_ORDER)}
MOD_COLOUR = {}
for st in ("pca", "knn", "cluster"):
    for i, m in enumerate(sorted(stages.loc[stages["stage"] == st, "module"].unique())):
        MOD_COLOUR[m] = fg.OMNICOL[i % len(fg.OMNICOL)]
STAGE_NAME = {"pca": "PCA", "knn": "kNN", "cluster": "Leiden"}


def raw(s):
    """Raw HTML into the page (an `output: asis` cell's printed text)."""
    print(f"\n```{{=html}}\n{s}\n```\n")


def table(df, digits=3):
    """A DataFrame as a plain HTML table: no notebook widget machinery, no remote scripts."""
    def cell(v):
        if isinstance(v, (float, np.floating)):
            return "—" if not np.isfinite(v) else f"{v:.{digits}f}"
        return html.escape(str(v))
    head = "".join(f"<th>{html.escape(str(c))}</th>" for c in df.columns)
    body = "".join("<tr>" + "".join(f"<td>{cell(v)}</td>" for v in row) + "</tr>"
                   for row in df.itertuples(index=False))
    raw(f'<div class="tbl"><table><thead><tr>{head}</tr></thead><tbody>{body}</tbody></table></div>')


def panels(data, y, ylabel, group, colours, logy=False, floors=None, note=None):
    """One panel per dataset: y against cells, one line per group. GPU (rapids) modules dashed.
    floors: optional frame with dataset, cells, label, value drawn as grey dotted lines."""
    fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, len(datasets), figsize=(3.3 * len(datasets), 3.0), sharey=True,
                             constrained_layout=True, squeeze=False)
    seen = {}
    for ax, d in zip(axes[0], datasets):
        s = data[data["dataset"] == d].sort_values("cells")
        if floors is not None and len(floors):
            for lab, f in floors[floors["dataset"] == d].sort_values("cells").groupby("label"):
                h = ax.plot(f["cells"], f["value"], ls=":", lw=1.2, color="#8c8b87")[0]
                seen.setdefault("own seed noise (grey)", h)
        for key, g in s.groupby(group):
            g = g.dropna(subset=[y])
            if len(g):
                ls = "--" if "rapids" in str(key) or "gpu" in str(key) or key == "hybrid" else "-"
                seen[key] = ax.plot(g["cells"], g[y], marker="o", ms=4, lw=1.4, ls=ls,
                                    color=colours.get(key, "#52514e"))[0]
        ax.set_xscale("log")
        ticks = sorted(s["cells"].dropna().unique())
        ax.set_xticks(ticks, [f"{c / 1000:g}k" for c in ticks])
        ax.xaxis.set_minor_formatter(plt.NullFormatter())
        if logy:
            ax.set_yscale("log")
        ax.set_title(d, loc="left")
        ax.set_xlabel("cells")
    axes[0][0].set_ylabel(ylabel)
    fig.legend(seen.values(), seen.keys(), loc="outside lower center", ncol=min(4, len(seen)),
               frameon=False, fontsize=7)
    display(fig)  # figures.py selects the Agg backend: plt.show() would draw nothing
    plt.close(fig)
    if note:
        print(f"\n{note}\n")


def st(stage):
    return stages[stages["stage"] == stage].rename(columns={"subsample": "size"})


def cols(t, names):
    return t[[c for c in names if c in t.columns]]


# ---- the four subtabs, one function each, the same for every stage ------------------------

def stability(stage):
    t = st(stage)
    if stage == "cluster":
        print("Agreement (ARI) between runs of one Leiden that differ only in its seed, at its oracle "
              "resolution; reproducibility: the same seed run again in another folder.\n")
        panels(t, "stage_stability", "stability (ARI between seeds)", "module", MOD_COLOUR,
               note="_Solid: CPU; dashed: GPU._")
    else:
        measure = ("variance-weighted subspace agreement" if stage == "pca" else "shared neighbours")
        print(f"Agreement between runs of one {STAGE_NAME[stage]} that differ only in its seed, on the "
              f"stage's own measure ({measure}), and downstream: the ARI of the final clusters "
              f"(baseline Leiden, seed 0). Exact modules have no seed: no stability.\n")
        panels(t, "stage_stability", f"stability ({measure})", "module", MOD_COLOUR)
        panels(t, "downstream_stability", "downstream stability (ARI)", "module", MOD_COLOUR,
               note="_Solid: CPU; dashed: GPU._")
    table(cols(t, ["module", "dataset", "size", "cells", "stage_stability", "stage_reproducibility",
                   "downstream_stability", "downstream_reproducibility"]).sort_values(["module", "dataset", "cells"]))


def concordance(stage):
    t = st(stage)
    if stage == "cluster":
        print("Do two Leiden implementations find the same partitions, beyond what each one's own "
              "seed noise explains? **Both gaps positive and significant**: they differ. **Only "
              "one**: the other is just noisier. Compared at equal resolutions, here at the "
              "baseline's oracle resolution; grey: each implementation's own seed noise.\n")
        if not len(leiden_tests):
            print("_No Leiden test: run analysis/phase2.py without --no_concordance._\n")
            return
        lt = leiden_tests.copy()
        lt[["dataset", "size"]] = lt["size"].str.split("/", n=1, expand=True)
        lt["res"] = lt["A"].str.extract(r"resolution=([0-9.]+)").astype(float)
        for c in ("A", "B"):
            lt[c] = lt[c].str.replace(r" resolution=[0-9.]+", "", regex=True)
        base = t[t["module"] == "cl-baseline"][["dataset", "size", "cells", "resolution"]]
        lt = lt.merge(base, on=["dataset", "size"])
        lt = lt[lt["res"].isna() | (lt["res"] == lt["resolution"])]
        lt["pair"] = lt["A"] + " vs " + lt["B"]
        floors = pd.concat([lt.assign(label=lt["A"], value=lt["within A median"]),
                            lt.assign(label=lt["B"], value=lt["within B median"])])
        panels(lt, "between median", "ARI between implementations", "pair",
               {p: fg.OMNICOL[i] for i, p in enumerate(sorted(lt["pair"].unique()))}, floors=floors)
        table(cols(lt, ["dataset", "size", "A", "B", "upstreams", "within A median", "within B median",
                        "between median", "gap A", "p A", "gap B", "p B"]), 4)
    else:
        c = stage_conc[stage_conc["stage"] == stage].rename(columns={"subsample": "size"}) if len(stage_conc) else pd.DataFrame()
        measure = "variance-weighted subspace agreement" if stage == "pca" else "shared neighbours"
        print(f"Agreement between two {STAGE_NAME[stage]} implementations on the stage's own measure "
              f"({measure}), against each one's own seed noise (grey). The permutation test where "
              "both ran several seeds; against an exact module (one run), the gap of the seeded side "
              "only. **Gap positive**: switching moves the result further than re-seeding does.\n")
        if not len(c):
            print("_No pairs._\n")
            return
        c = c.merge(t[["dataset", "size", "cells"]].drop_duplicates(), on=["dataset", "size"])
        c["pair"] = c["A"] + " vs " + c["B"]
        floors = t.dropna(subset=["stage_stability"]).assign(label=lambda x: x["module"], value=lambda x: x["stage_stability"])
        panels(c, "between median", ("subspace agreement" if stage == "pca" else "shared neighbours"), "pair",
               {p: fg.OMNICOL[i % len(fg.OMNICOL)] for i, p in enumerate(sorted(c["pair"].unique()))}, floors=floors)
        table(cols(c, ["dataset", "size", "A", "B", "within A median", "within B median", "between median",
                       "gap A", "p A", "gap B", "p B"]), 4)


def accuracy(stage):
    t = st(stage)
    if stage == "cluster":
        print("ARI of the final clusters against the reference labels, as a share of the oracle "
              "bound (1: as good as a classifier trained on the labels), each Leiden at its own "
              "oracle resolution.\n")
        panels(t, "accuracy_share", "accuracy (share of oracle)", "module", MOD_COLOUR)
        sl = runs[runs["varies"].isin(["none", "cluster"]) & (runs["pca_seed"].astype(str) == "0")
                  & (runs["knn_seed"].astype(str) == "0")]
        acc = (sl.groupby(["cluster", "dataset", "subsample", "resolution"])["ari_truth"].median()
               .unstack("resolution").reset_index().rename(columns={"cluster": "module", "subsample": "size"}))
        acc.columns = [f"resolution {c:g}" if isinstance(c, float) else c for c in acc.columns]
        print("**Median ARI at every resolution** (each row's best is its oracle resolution)\n")
        table(acc.sort_values(["module", "dataset", "size"]))
    else:
        what = ("share of the exact top-50 variance the method's subspace holds" if stage == "pca"
                else "recall of the exact (brute-force) neighbours")
        print(f"**Fidelity to exact**: {what}. **Downstream accuracy**: ARI of the final clusters "
              "(baseline Leiden, seed 0) against the labels as a share of the oracle bound, at the "
              "baseline pipeline's oracle resolution, so another resolution cannot rescue a worse "
              f"{STAGE_NAME[stage]}.\n")
        panels(t, "fidelity", "fidelity to exact", "module", MOD_COLOUR)
        panels(t, "accuracy_share", "downstream accuracy (share of oracle)", "module", MOD_COLOUR,
               note="_Solid: CPU; dashed: GPU._")
    table(cols(t, ["module", "dataset", "size", "cells", "resolution", "fidelity", "accuracy_ari",
                   "accuracy_share"]).sort_values(["module", "dataset", "cells"]))


def cost(stage):
    t = st(stage)
    what = "one Leiden run" if stage == "cluster" else f"the {STAGE_NAME[stage]} job"
    print(f"Wall time of {what}: start-up and imports included, queue excluded. Cold starts (the first "
          "rapids job of a module in a folder, GPU kernels compiled on first use) left out where "
          "there are others.\n")
    panels(t, "cost_s", "wall time (s)", "module", MOD_COLOUR, logy=True, note="_Solid: CPU; dashed: GPU._")
    table(cols(t, ["module", "dataset", "size", "cells", "cost_s"]).sort_values(["module", "dataset", "cells"]), 2)
```

:::::: {.panel-tabset}

## Overview

**Question.** Which PCA → kNN → Leiden pipeline gives the best stability, accuracy and cost, and
how does that change with the number of cells? Where do differences between implementations
come from, stage by stage? And when is a GPU worth it, measured rather than assumed? Plan and
definitions: `docs/phase2-plan.md`.

**Design.** Each stage tab reads its own slice of the plan: that stage varies, the other two
stay at the exact baselines (covariance-eigh PCA, brute-force kNN, leidenalg run to
convergence) with their seed fixed, so every difference belongs to that stage. The Full
pipeline tab reads five named end-to-end pipelines with matched seeds.

| Pipeline | PCA | kNN | Leiden |
|---|---|---|---|
| baseline | covariance-eigh (CPU) | brute force (CPU) | leidenalg |
| scanpy-defaults | arpack | pynndescent, 1 thread | igraph, 2 iterations |
| tuned-cpu | randomized (CPU) | pynndescent, 8 threads | leidenalg |
| all-gpu | covariance-eigh (GPU) | brute force (GPU) | cuGraph |
| hybrid | covariance-eigh (GPU) | brute force (GPU) | leidenalg |

```{python}
#| output: asis
folders = runs["run"].fillna("").astype(str).nunique() if len(runs) else 0
print(f"**This report:** {len(runs):,} clusterings, {len(datasets)} datasets, {len(bounds)} dataset × "
      f"size combinations, {folders} output folder(s)"
      f"{' (same-seed replicates: reproducibility is measured)' if folders > 1 else ''}.\n")
table(bounds.rename(columns={"subsample": "size", "oracle_logreg": "oracle: logistic regression",
                             "oracle_knn": "oracle: 15-NN", "oracle": "oracle (the better)"})[
    ["dataset", "size", "cells", "labels", "chance", "oracle: logistic regression", "oracle: 15-NN",
     "oracle (the better)"]])
```

| Subtab | What it shows |
|---|---|
| **Stability** | Agreement between runs that differ only in a seed, in one output folder; **reproducibility**: the same seed run again in another folder, the floor under stability. PCA and kNN on their own measure and downstream (final clusters). |
| **Concordance** | Agreement between implementations, against each one's own seed noise (grey), with a permutation test where both ran several seeds. |
| **Accuracy** | PCA and kNN: **fidelity** to the exact module (variance-weighted share of the exact top-50 variance; recall of the exact neighbours) and downstream accuracy. Leiden: ARI against the reference labels as a share of the range between chance (0) and the oracle bound. |
| **Cost** | Wall time of the stage's own job; per answer (the whole resolution sweep) in Full pipeline. |

**Resolutions.** Leiden runs at five resolutions. The PCA and kNN tabs read downstream results at
the **baseline pipeline's oracle resolution** (best median accuracy over seeds), so a worse stage
cannot be rescued by another resolution; the Leiden tab and Full pipeline read each
implementation or pipeline at **its own** oracle resolution. Both are oracle choices, which a
user without labels cannot make.

## Full pipeline

The five named pipelines, each at its own oracle resolution, as in Ben's deck: accuracy over
seeds against the chance and oracle bounds, stability, reproducibility and wall time per answer
(PCA and kNN once, Leiden at every resolution of the sweep).

```{python}
#| output: asis
if not len(pipes):
    print("_No named pipelines in these results: run the pipelines slice (scripts/run_pipelines.sh)._\n")
else:
    p = pipes.rename(columns={"subsample": "size"})
    # accuracy distributions: one panel per dataset at its largest size, one ECDF per pipeline
    pr = pipe_runs.rename(columns={"subsample": "size"})
    fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, len(datasets), figsize=(3.3 * len(datasets), 3.0), sharey=True,
                             constrained_layout=True, squeeze=False)
    for ax, d in zip(axes[0], datasets):
        cells_max = p.loc[p["dataset"] == d, "cells"].max()
        sub = pr[(pr["dataset"] == d) & (pr["size"].isin(p.loc[(p["dataset"] == d) & (p["cells"] == cells_max), "size"]))]
        for name in PIPE_ORDER:
            v = np.sort(sub.loc[sub["named"] == name, "accuracy_share"].dropna().to_numpy())
            if len(v):
                ax.step(np.r_[v[0], v], np.r_[0, np.arange(1, len(v) + 1) / len(v)], where="post",
                        color=PIPE_COLOUR[name], lw=1.6, ls="--" if name in ("all-gpu", "hybrid") else "-", label=name)
        for x, lab in ((0, "chance"), (1, "oracle")):
            ax.axvline(x, color="#8c8b87", ls=":", lw=1)
        ax.set_title(f"{d} · {cells_max / 1000:g}k cells", loc="left")
        ax.set_xlabel("accuracy (share of oracle)")
    axes[0][0].set_ylabel("share of runs ≤ x")
    h, l = axes[0][0].get_legend_handles_labels()
    fig.legend(h, l, loc="outside lower center", ncol=5, frameon=False, fontsize=7)
    display(fig)
    plt.close(fig)
    print("\n_Accuracy over seeds at each dataset's largest size; grey: chance (0) and oracle (1)._\n")
    panels(p, "accuracy_share", "accuracy (share of oracle)", "pipeline", PIPE_COLOUR)
    panels(p, "stability", "stability (ARI between seeds)", "pipeline", PIPE_COLOUR)
    panels(p, "cost_s", "wall time per answer (s)", "pipeline", PIPE_COLOUR, logy=True,
           note="_Dashed: pipelines with GPU stages._")
    table(cols(p, ["pipeline", "dataset", "size", "cells", "oracle_resolution", "runs", "accuracy_ari",
                   "accuracy_share", "stability", "reproducibility", "cost_s"]).sort_values(["dataset", "cells", "pipeline"]))
    # two measures at a time: one row per dataset at its largest size
    big = p[p["cells"] == p.groupby("dataset")["cells"].transform("max")]
    trio = [("cost_s", "stability", "Cost against stability"),
            ("cost_s", "accuracy_share", "Cost against accuracy"),
            ("stability", "accuracy_share", "Accuracy against stability")]
    label = {"cost_s": "wall time per answer (s)", "stability": "stability",
             "accuracy_share": "accuracy (share of oracle)"}
    print("\n### Two measures at a time\n")
    fig, axes = plt.subplots(len(datasets), 3, figsize=(10, 3.0 * len(datasets)),
                             constrained_layout=True, squeeze=False)
    for row, d in zip(axes, datasets):
        sub = big[big["dataset"] == d]
        for ax, (x, y, title) in zip(row, trio):
            for _, r in sub.iterrows():
                ax.scatter(r[x], r[y], s=45, color=PIPE_COLOUR[r["pipeline"]], label=r["pipeline"])
            if x == "cost_s":
                ax.set_xscale("log")
                ax.xaxis.set_major_formatter(mticker.FuncFormatter(lambda v, _: f"{v:g}"))
                ax.xaxis.set_minor_formatter(mticker.NullFormatter())
            ax.set_xlabel(label[x]); ax.set_ylabel(label[y])
            ax.set_title(f"{d} · {sub['cells'].max() / 1000:g}k · {title}", loc="left", fontsize=8)
    h, l = axes[0][0].get_legend_handles_labels()
    fig.legend(h, l, loc="outside lower center", ncol=5, frameon=False, fontsize=7)
    display(fig)
    plt.close(fig)

    # trade-off with the weights set at the top of this file
    w = WEIGHTS
    p["tradeoff"] = (w["accuracy"] * p["accuracy_share"] + w["stability"] * p["stability"]
                     - w["cost"] * p["log10_cost_vs_fastest"])
    print(f"\n### Trade-off\n\ntrade-off = {w['accuracy']:g} × accuracy + {w['stability']:g} × stability "
          f"− {w['cost']:g} × log10(cost / fastest cost at that dataset and size). Absolute scales, so a "
          "pipeline's score does not change when another is added. The weights are a preference, set in "
          "`WEIGHTS` at the top of report/phase2.qmd.\n")
    panels(p, "tradeoff", "trade-off", "pipeline", PIPE_COLOUR)

    # fastest pipeline clearing both thresholds
    t = THRESHOLDS
    ok = p[(p["accuracy_share"] >= t["accuracy"]) & (p["stability"] >= t["stability"])]
    best = []
    for (d, size), g in p.groupby(["dataset", "size"]):
        o = ok[(ok["dataset"] == d) & (ok["size"] == size)].sort_values("cost_s")
        best.append({"dataset": d, "size": size, "cells": g["cells"].iloc[0],
                     "fastest pipeline": o["pipeline"].iloc[0] if len(o) else "none meets both",
                     "wall time (s)": o["cost_s"].iloc[0] if len(o) else np.nan,
                     "pipelines meeting both": len(o)})
    print(f"\n### Fastest pipeline meeting the thresholds\n\nAccuracy ≥ {t['accuracy']:g} and stability "
          f"≥ {t['stability']:g} (`THRESHOLDS` at the top of report/phase2.qmd); no weights.\n")
    table(pd.DataFrame(best).sort_values(["dataset", "cells"]))
```
